description.value: Cornucopia is a supermarket serving the small lakeside community of Kaslo, BC in the Kootenay region. For touring cyclists on routes through the Kootenays, it represents a rare full-service grocery resupply point in an otherwise remote stretch of riding. The town of Kaslo itself is a popular overnight destination on multi-day touring routes.
